plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: GatePass uses your location to show parking near you and, if you list a space, to place it on the map. Your location is never shared with other users.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: GatePass only uses your location while you're using the app: to show parking near you and, if you list a space, to place it on the map. It is never shared with other users.
plugins.locationAlwaysPermission: GatePass only uses your location while you're using the app: to show parking near you and, if you list a space, to place it on the map. It is never shared with other users.

plugins.photosPermission: GatePass uses your photo library so you can add pictures of your parking space, your ownership document, or a problem you report.
plugins.cameraPermission: GatePass uses the camera only if you choose to take a photo of your parking space or a problem you report.
